name: alternate heel touch side kick squat
source_instructions: Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
interpretation: Two complete hip-width squats alternate same-side heel-touch side kicks over an authored eight-second bilateral cycle. Each squat descends for0.9s and returns fully to standing over0.8s with both soles planted. A separate0.25s soft-knee weight transfer precedes foot lift. Only then does the accepted lateral kick, slight rechamber and relaxed little-fingertip medial/posterior heel tap run, followed by controlled landing and recentering. The source specifies no numerical duration, so the rejected five-second overlap is replaced rather than compressed. Squat depth, weights, four capped target shapes and the reachable neutral-wrist contact method are unchanged.

shared_geometry.3480_preservation: The3479 canonical container retains original3480 geometry, joint hierarchy, animation objects/accessors and complete original BIN prefix byte-exact. Per-ID3480 source/GLB files remain byte-identical to the previously accepted delivery.

correctives.runtime: Four compact additive standard glTF POSITION/NORMAL targets before linear skinning. Active rear-knee lunge target or active-side heel-touch shoulder target; all unrelated keys explicitly zero.
correctives.construction: One local CorrectiveSmooth20x1.0 target per mirrored diagnosed collar, C1 source domain, exact inverse LBS and C1 radial25mm cap. No runtime DQ or smoothing.
